scope: Local synthetic isolated QA; not production acceptance. Export capacity preceded the sidebar-only v5 structural pagination change; v5 actual template exports and rerenders are independently checked. Main HTTP report preceded the final conflict presentation change, which has separate targeted real HTTP evidence.

checks: complete base template + cold major quiz immediately operable
real progress revision + questionnaire survives refresh
real answers API returns personal baseline and direction cards
real favorite/hide revisions survive refresh; filtered graph/list agree including an empty result; hidden direction can be restored
real resume layout + draft snapshot personal edit does not mutate profile
real lease CAS worker publishes exact frozen HTML and preview version
real candidate accept creates immutable revision then real renderer publishes it
real history restore creates new version; pinned historical preview and Word HTTP export preserve selected version
real revision saves retain accepted summary/capabilities and allow direct text editing without updating source materials
real 409 preserves typed input and exposes explicit reload
real multipart avatar upload increments revision; the next profile save uses the new revision without self-conflict
real 202 personal suggestion uses durable worker, resume-by-job-id, selection review and explicit profile save
real 202 self-intro suggestion preserves original until side-by-side acceptance
other student denied resume/version/candidate/job/preview/export and mutation endpoints; failed editor retains navigation
real 409 keeps input; Chinese text summary includes edited fields/capabilities, no technical keys or executable markup, no automatic download
explicit backup download is parseable and byte-for-field equivalent to the complete rejected payload, including hidden provenance/layout/revision
return-to-edit retains local input; explicit load-latest restores the server revision without overwriting it
downloaded backup recreates a separate editable draft through the existing API, preserving text/capabilities/material edits and the original server version
report.recovery_scope: Existing API data recovery verified; this change does not add a JSON import UI.

report.measurement_scope: Real local LibreOffice PDFs through production frozen templates/cache. Only QA-owned profile processes sampled. soffice.com/exe launchers are reported separately from the heavy soffice.bin converter. Permanent lock files remain by design; active OS locks and metadata must clear. Desktop evidence is not a production SLA.

majors: 机械设计制造及其自动化
report.measurement_scope: Real FastAPI ASGI command admission and PostgreSQL transactions, pool max12. No TCP/TLS/session middleware, workers, real AI, Office or email. HTTP 200 is the current career API's accepted-and-persisted contract; task completion is not measured.
report.dataset_scope: Ten cold majors, real student/class rows, fixture-only seed resume materials for students1/2; no generated network cache. Quiz initialization and validation/deduplication/overload controls are outside main-wave latency.

report.scope: Synthetic long Chinese resume only. Sidebar direct PDF plus existing LibreOffice DOCX-to-PDF output. No Microsoft Word application compatibility claim. No Office process was started by this reviewer.
report.method: Direct PDF rendered with bundled Poppler pdftoppm at 150 dpi; existing qa-docx-sidebar full-page PNGs inspected as supplied. Every page independently viewed with view_image; no text extraction or contact sheet substituted.

findings.description: 首栏姓名与部分侧栏文字贴近色块左边界，视觉内边距偏紧；字形全部可读，未见剪裁。此为 v4 已有样式观察，不影响此次分页修复验收。

structural_evidence.note: Static OOXML inspection supplements visual result; attributes alone do not establish pagination correctness.
